summary: End-to-end verified iter69 — WelcomeTour non-blocking fix, workspace-switcher always-open menu, templates picker, and the NEW Team Roles feature (UI + backend). Backend: 7/7 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration69_team_roles.py covering GET/POST/DELETE /api/dev-projects/{pid}/role-claims, 400 on bad role, switching releases prior role, /talk now accepts role_key without 422 and is backwards-compat without it. Frontend: all 20 UI checks pass — nav-dashboard clickable while welcome-tour-card is on screen, workspace-switcher-menu opens with invite & manage shortcuts both navigating to /team, np-pick-template opens template-picker with 17 templates and pre-fills np-name/np-description/np-problem, team-roles-strip shows 12 claimable tiles, claiming 'frontend' sets self-badge to 'You · Frontend Dev' and ds-input placeholder to 'As frontend, describe a change…', switching to 'qa' replaces the role (one-per-user invariant), release-self clears the badge.
action_items: (Cosmetic / spec-compliance nit) WelcomeTour.jsx — the inline comment says 'Auto-dismiss whenever the user navigates somewhere' but the useEffect on location.pathname only removes the sessionStorage flag; it does NOT call setOpen(false). The card stays visually pinned in the bottom-right after nav until the user clicks X or the slide CTA. The spec explicitly states 'auto-dismisses on the first route change (sessionStorage flag tn:show-welcome-tour cleared)' — the flag IS cleared (so it won't re-fire next session), and the card is non-blocking, but if the intent was for the card to vanish on first nav, add setOpen(false) inside the location.pathname effect.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/dev_os.py:role-claim endpoints look solid — proper workspace scoping, 400/404/409/403 status codes, one-role-per-user invariant enforced atomically on the claim path. Good.

routes/dev_os.py:release_role returns 200 with the unchanged claims map when the user doesn't currently hold the role (no-op semantics) — that's friendly, but the docstring should mention the no-op-when-not-held case explicitly.

TalkToBuildRequest.role_key is Optional[str] without an Enum/Literal — service layer should validate it against CLAIMABLE_ROLE_KEYS to avoid the LLM being biased by a typoed role (silent failure path).
WelcomeTour.jsx — see action_items; doc-vs-impl drift on the auto-dismiss-on-nav behavior.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 — 1 skipped sanity test for pricing endpoint paths)

The UI test harness for this iteration was executed inline via mcp_browser_automation; if you want a reusable Playwright spec, save the script in tests/e2e/ — every flow uses data-testids that already exist on the page so it's stable.
rca of the issue: n/a — feature + bug-fix verification all passed first run. The only finding is a docstring/impl drift in WelcomeTour.jsx where the comment promises auto-dismiss-on-route-change but only the sessionStorage flag is cleared (the visible card persists until manually skipped). Functionally non-blocking because the card is fixed-bottom-right with pointer-events:auto only on itself, so sidebar/nav clicks work fine — which is the actual user-impacting requirement of the bug fix.
